p9_ocr0.caption: TABLE 2. Operational constraints considered in the proposed energy management strategy.
rows: Battery SOC is constrained within predefined minimum and maximum limits during operation, while the terminal SOC condition is enforced via equivalence factor iteration.
Battery and electric machine power are limited by inverter and hardware constraints and are respected in the control allocation.
ICE start–stop decisions are constrained to discrete vehicle state transitions, which enforces a minimum on/off duration at the state level.
Thermal operation is constrained to the validated operating envelope of the demonstrator; thermal dynamics are not explicitly optimized and are assumed to remain within safe limits.
